* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor (V) (Errata)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-11-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual18-Light/large/deathstarlevel6coreshaftcorridor.gif</code> as published 11 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual18-Light/large/deathstarlevel6coreshaftcorridor.gif holotable commit 6894629] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: Your stormtroopers here may move to an adjacent site as a 'react.' Dark: If you occupy, opponent's Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor game text is canceled.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF at a larger size (745×534 → 1039×745 pixels) with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, which re-made 51 landscape card images that day; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name); it is the same card enlarged, with the same rounded transparent corners — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged. A visible (resolution) change, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Card image published 5 July 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set18Type.html Virtual Set 18 card list]<ref name="img-2022-07-05-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual18-Light/large/deathstarlevel6coreshaftcorridor.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual18-Light/large/deathstarlevel6coreshaftcorridor.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: Your stormtroopers here may move to an adjacent site as a 'react.' Dark: If you occupy, opponent's Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor game text is canceled.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. The white background around the rounded corners of the image became black.
